title: Unexplained jargon: EV, Fair, Best, Edge, consensus-only, no-vig
steps: Read slate header "BEST LINE · BOOK / FAIR · EDGE", game table headers EV/FAIR/BEST, "consensus-only" on every row
expected: One-line plain-English hint (tap/underline) for each term, e.g. "Fair = what the line should be without the bookmaker's cut"
actual: Only the landing FAQ touches edge/EV; slate, game page and Edge Finder use FAIR, EV, consensus-only with no definition. Edge Finder explains edge with "fair probability x decimal odds - 1", which a casual user cannot use.
